System guide / Knowledge base / Documents and manuals

Documents and manuals

29 indexed equipment references, including 26 PDFs downloaded November 11, 2026. Search by model, part, terminal, symptom or fault code using “Search all records.” PDF results open at the matching physical PDF page; the catalog link gives applicability and source context.

Manufacturer specifications describe products; field observations describe this installation. A family or candidate match does not establish replacement compatibility or as-built wiring. Extracted text may miss scanned drawings, symbols or tables; consult the original PDF. PDF page numbers below count from the first PDF page and can differ from printed page numbers.

Equipment coverage and identification gaps · Source and search notes

Wirsbo DuoMix 201 installation handbook — A3030005

Exact model

Download PDF · 32 pages · 1.42 MB · Source

Publisher / revision
Wirsbo / tekmar · Revision date not established; 32-page handbook
Acquired
2026-11-11
Equipment
MC-1 · hydronic mixing controller · Mix 1 · first-floor distribution circulator · Mix 2 · upstairs distribution circulator · Var 1 · first-floor injection circulator · Var 2 · upstairs injection circulator · Outdoor sensor · SUP 1 · mixed supply sensor · SUP 2 · mixed supply sensor · Common heating return probe

Applicability: Names DuoMix 201 and A3030005. Installed settings and actual field wiring still require verification. This is not the proMix 201 manual. Some display and drawing pages have little extractable text; consult the PDF.

Two injection-mixing circuits, outdoor reset, demand inputs, sensor wiring, DIP switches, display menus, output tests and sensor fault messages. Page 8 identifies Mix 2 demand at 3–4 and its pump at 7–8. OPEN is qualified by the displayed sensor name; it is not by itself a diagnosis of a valve end switch.

  • PDF p. 3: Demand logic and boiler return protection
  • PDF p. 6: Power, demand, pump and sensor terminal connections
  • PDF p. 7: Sensor wiring and resistance testing
  • PDF p. 8: Resistance table and powered input/output checks
  • PDF p. 9: DIP switches and settings
  • PDF p. 12: Display symbols
  • PDF p. 19: Control test routine
  • PDF p. 20: MAX HEAT and sensor faults: OUTDOOR, Boil RET, SUPPLY OPEN/SHRT
  • PDF p. 26: Variable-speed injection mixing design

Pages with little extractable text (drawings, blank or scanned pages): 17, 18, 22, 23, 24, 25, 30, 31, 32. Open the PDF to inspect them.

Source and search notes

Original PDFs are preserved locally. Manufacturer-hosted copies were preferred; legacy manufacturer documents were obtained from public mirrors when needed. The BuyTaco table is labelled as a distributor reference. Revision and applicability are recorded above. The machine-readable catalog records source/download URLs, acquisition dates and SHA-256 checksums. Page text supports local search; no network service is needed after the site loads. Search does not OCR images and does not replace reading diagrams.

Later-generation Polaris Series 200/201 instructions, European Caleffi data and duplicate downloads were excluded. Exact legacy A303XX0003 module documentation was not located; the later A3031003 guide is explicitly qualified. Nest hardware generation and unrecorded component identities remain open.
